bullets.text: AI Security Nightmare Unveiled - A hacker exploited **Cline** to install **OpenClaw**, highlighting vulnerabilities in AI tools.
Samsung's One UI 8.5 Beta - New **Bixby** features are rolling out, enhancing user experience for **Galaxy S25** owners.
Apple's March Launch Rumours - Anticipation builds for multiple product announcements without a keynote event.
Reddit Tests AI Shopping Tool - A new feature matches community recommendations with products from partners.
Ring's Controversial Surveillance - A leaked email confirms plans to use **Ring** for human identification, sparking backlash.
Apple Music & TikTok Collaboration - New features allow users to enjoy full songs and host listening parties.
YouTube Expands AI Tool to TVs - Users can now interact with a conversational AI while watching videos.
Texas Sues TP-Link Over China Ties - Allegations claim the company misleads customers about its connections to China.
Nvidia's AI Startup Push in India - The company deepens its engagement with early-stage AI startups in the region.
ATM Jackpotting Attacks Surge - The FBI reports a rise in ATM jackpotting, netting hackers millions.
